reason: Conversation 2 explains dE as a door-not-locked error straight away, picks up the 'springs back' clue, and has the customer remove the duvet. That confirms the cause (overfilled drum, no fault) in a few turns, with no part recommended. Its final explanation wrongly calls it an unbalanced-load fault rather than the duvet blocking the latch, but the practical conclusion (machine is fine, don't overload with the duvet) is right. Conversation 1 said it couldn't confirm what dE means, kept asking about child lock after the customer had said it only happens with the duvet, never had the duvet removed, and ended without a clear resolution or a suggestion to reduce the load or use a launderette.
